title: The Twin Pillar Formation Discipline
summary: A school discipline that raises formations on two pillars of qi and grows from a simple ward into a crushing pair.

title: The Hawk and River Array Reckoning
summary: A school reckoning of arrays that watch from above and follow the current of the foe's qi down to the stoop.

title: The Dual-Track Crown Formation
summary: A school formation worked on two tracks about the Core that crowns the maker in a ring of ward and mending.

title: Bearing and Oath Formation Foundation
summary: A school foundation of formations sworn to a bearing that grow from tied cords into one binding oath.

title: The Open Heading Formation Canon
summary: A school canon of open formations that ride the wind and pass the maker through them toward an unbound strike.

title: The Wind-Sworn Crown Formation
summary: A school formation sworn to the wind that crowns the maker in a storm of ward and mending about the Core.
